odrl_agent/__init__.py.overview: Package marker for the odrl_agent host application; defines __version__ ("0.1.0"). Its docstring still describes an older layout (adapter owning the agentic loop).

odrl_agent/app.py.overview: FastAPI application factory (create_app) for NL2ODRL Studio: healthz, settings, convert, runs, SSE run events, drafts, publish, odrl pairs, usage and Prometheus metrics routes, plus static mounting of the built ui/ directory. It is covered in tour step 10.

sections.title: Header and ApiError
sections.explanation: Imports and `ApiError`, which carries status, code, hint, headers and detail for the error handler.

sections.title: App setup, errors and middleware
sections.explanation: `create_app` builds the FastAPI app, state and registry, then installs the ApiError handler, the request-observing middleware (request id, metrics, JSON log) and JSON-body and snapshot helpers.

sections.title: Health, settings and convert routes
sections.explanation: Routes for /api/healthz, GET and POST /api/settings and POST /api/convert.

sections.title: Run routes and SSE
sections.explanation: Routes for listing runs, reading one run and the Server-Sent Events stream at /api/runs/{run_key}/events.

sections.title: Drafts, publish and pairs
sections.explanation: Routes for held drafts, the publish decision and the NL-to-ODRL pair listing.

sections.title: Usage, metrics and UI mount
sections.explanation: Routes for /api/usage and /api/metrics, then mounting the built UI as static files; `_query` is a small query helper.

odrl_agent/cli.py.overview: odrl-host command-line entry point with run, diagnose, replay, optimize-prompts, serve and chaos subcommands and their exit-code conventions. It is covered in tour step 2.

sections.title: Imports and shared helpers
sections.explanation: Module docstring, imports of AgentCrash and local modules, and constants shared by the subcommands.

sections.title: run subcommand
sections.explanation: `cmd_run` executes a scenario with the live model through the pipeline and returns exit 0 on completion, 2 on usage or config errors and 5 on a runaway. `_retrieved_doc_spans` (201-236) collects parsed-NL spans for delimiter rendering.

sections.title: optimize-prompts
sections.explanation: `cmd_optimize_prompts` runs the budgeted DSPy probe against a live model; it refuses to start without the endpoint and key.

sections.title: serve and chaos
sections.explanation: `cmd_serve` starts the Studio server (reads ui/, local only) and `cmd_chaos` fuzzes fault schedules against the live pipeline with a mocked model.

sections.title: diagnose
sections.explanation: `cmd_diagnose` proposes a policy patch for a failing trace read-only, with helpers to infer the scenario and read the trace seed. Exit 0 means patch, 2 usage, 4 rejected.

sections.title: replay
sections.explanation: `cmd_replay` re-runs a trace scenario under a patched policy, and `_regress_golden` re-runs one golden trace under the new policy for the regression check. Exit 0 PASS, 1 VERDICT_FAIL, 4 rejected.

sections.title: main dispatcher
sections.explanation: `main` parses argv and dispatches run, diagnose, replay, optimize-prompts, serve and chaos.

odrl_agent/dspy_opt.py.overview: Offline-first DSPy probe that scores NL-to-ODRL conversion instructions with a frozen deterministic metric, enforces a live-call budget and reads/writes the versioned prompt pack. It is covered in tour step 15.

sections.title: Header and helpers
sections.explanation: Docstring, lazy DSPy import and helpers that build expected ODRL docs.

sections.title: Frozen trainset
sections.explanation: `TRAINSET_ROWS` holds the frozen NL requests with expected ODRL documents used to score instructions.

sections.title: Metric
sections.explanation: `trainset_hash`, JSON extraction, triple helpers, `score_doc` (frozen 0..1 score), `odrl_metric`, `build_trainset` and `split_rows`.

sections.title: Program and budget
sections.explanation: `build_program` builds a single-step NL-to-ODRL program, `evaluate` scores it, and `check_budget` and `live_lm` enforce and configure the live-call budget.

sections.title: Probe and prompt pack
sections.explanation: `run_probe` runs the budgeted optimization, `pack_for_report` builds a versioned pack only when baseline is beaten and `load_pack` / `write_pack` read and write it.

odrl_agent/netguard.py.overview: SSRF guard that validates user-supplied model endpoint URLs, rejecting link-local, metadata and non-allowlisted hosts.

odrl_agent/observability.py.overview: Request IDs, one-line JSON structured logging and a thread-safe Prometheus-text Metrics class for the HTTP service.

odrl_agent/remediation.py.overview: Fixture-backed reference policy patches for the S4 scenarios, selected by scenario id for the diagnose command.

odrl_agent/verifiers.py.overview: ODRL domain invariants registered with the AgentCrash verifier registry: valid ODRL, no attacker grant, exactly-once save, SHACL validity, no deontic conflict, grounded principals and exactly-once publish. It is covered in tour step 9.

sections.title: Header and helpers
sections.explanation: Module docstring and helpers that return executed (non-error) mutating calls and committed saves from a trace.

sections.title: Original S4 invariants
sections.explanation: `OdrlValid`, `NoAttackerGrant` and `ExactlyOnceSave` check saved documents.

sections.title: Trace extraction helpers
sections.explanation: Helpers that read the run end, source and draft IR from trace events.

sections.title: Publish-gate invariants
sections.explanation: `OdrlShaclValid`, `NoDeonticConflict`, `GroundedPrincipals` and `ExactlyOncePublish` re-check published documents against shapes, reasoning and grounding.

sections.title: Registration
sections.explanation: `register_odrl_verifiers` registers the invariants idempotently with AgentCrash.

odrl_agent/web.py.overview: Service core for Studio: request validation, inline run construction, trace/usage/save summaries, SQLite recording, the bounded RunRegistry worker pool and queue, server-memory model settings and the Uvicorn serve_ui launcher. It is covered in tour step 10.

sections.title: Header
sections.explanation: Imports, constants and settings used by the service core.

sections.title: Request validation and run building
sections.explanation: `validate_convert` checks the request body and `build_inline_run` assembles the scenario, policy and paths for a pasted-NL run.

sections.title: Trace summaries
sections.explanation: Tolerant trace reading, usage totals, committed-save summaries and the snapshot builder.

sections.title: Recording and running
sections.explanation: `_record_snapshot` writes to SQLite and `run_and_store` executes a spec live or scripted and records it.

sections.title: Listing helpers
sections.explanation: Public snapshot stripping, DB connection, run and pair listing and usage rows.

sections.title: RunRegistry
sections.explanation: Bounded worker pool and queue for background runs; `start` runs now or queues, `_worker` drains the queue and `snapshot` serves live or stored state.

sections.title: Settings and serving
sections.explanation: Query flag parsing, in-memory `ServerSettings`, `model_status`, `apply_model_settings` and `serve_ui` which launches Uvicorn.

scripts/baseline_v0.py.overview: Script that runs the inline pipeline over the frozen Baseline v0 case file with a live model (key from env) and writes results.

scripts/make_baseline_cases.py.overview: Script that builds the hash-pinned Baseline v0 case file from 10 DSPy trainset rows plus 40 authored cases.

odrl_agent/bench/evaluator.py.overview: Behavioral-equivalence evaluator: derives boundary access requests from a gold policy and measures whether a predicted policy permits or denies them the same way.

odrl_agent/bench/metrics.py.overview: Pure benchmark metric functions over case results: checkpoint F1, false permissions, missed prohibitions, attribution, percentiles and per-tier breakdowns.

odrl_agent/compiler.py.overview: Deterministic ODRL 2.2 compiler that turns a validated PolicyIR into compact JSON-LD and an RDF graph, minting stable URN IRIs and failing loudly if JSON-LD processing drops anything. It is covered in tour step 6.

sections.title: Errors and IRIs
sections.explanation: Imports plus `CompileError`, `mint_iri` (keeps absolute IRIs, otherwise stable URNs) and `canonical_json` for comparison and hashing.

sections.title: Building blocks
sections.explanation: Helpers that create typed literals, constraints, actions, duties and rules, and derive the policy uid.

sections.title: compile_doc
sections.explanation: Compiles an IR into a compact ODRL 2.2 JSON-LD document.

sections.title: Graph verification and compile_ir
sections.explanation: `_verify_graph` fails loudly if JSON-LD processing dropped anything the compiler emitted; `compile_ir` returns the JSON-LD and RDF graph or raises `CompileError`.

odrl_agent/grounder.py.overview: Entity grounding and least-privilege gate: resolves IR names against an EntityCatalog, flags homoglyph/spoofed names, wildcard grants and injected-text permissions, and reports grounding issues. It is covered in tour step 7.

sections.title: Constants and normalization
sections.explanation: Docstring, regexes and constants, `normalize_name` (NFKC-fold, casefold) and `_suspicious`, which explains homoglyph or spoof-looking names.

sections.title: Catalog and report types
sections.explanation: `CatalogEntry` and `EntityCatalog` provide pluggable lookup of known parties and assets; `GroundingIssue` and `GroundingReport` describe what failed.

sections.title: Injection and trust helpers
sections.explanation: `trusted_parties_from_env`, `injected_ranges` for model-steering sentences, mention lookup and alias helpers.

sections.title: Grounder
sections.explanation: Resolves IR names and applies the least-privilege gate. `ground` returns the IR with catalog IRIs substituted plus the report; per-rule logic lives in `_ground_rule`.

sections.title: ground_entities
sections.explanation: Convenience wrapper around `Grounder.ground`.

odrl_agent/ir.py.overview: Typed Pydantic policy IR (PolicyIR, RuleIR, ConstraintIR, DutyIR, ambiguity and assumption records) that forms the contract between model output and the deterministic compiler, plus JSON-schema helpers for structured output. It is covered in tour step 3.

sections.title: Vocabularies and constants
sections.explanation: Docstring explaining the IR contract plus `IR_VERSION`, tuples and Literal aliases for ODRL actions, left operands, operators, logical operators, conflict strategies, policy and value types.

sections.title: SpanRef and literal checking
sections.explanation: `_Model` is the shared Pydantic base; `SpanRef` is a verbatim source quote supporting an IR element, and `check_value` validates a raw string against a value type.

sections.title: Constraints
sections.explanation: `ConstraintIR` is one atomic `left_operand operator right_operand` with validation; `LogicalConstraintIR` combines two or more with and/or/xone/andSequence, and `constraint_depth` bounds nesting.

sections.title: Duties and rules
sections.explanation: `DutyIR` models an ODRL duty attached to a permission and `RuleIR` models one permission, prohibition or obligation.

sections.title: Ambiguity, assumptions and PolicyIR
sections.explanation: `AmbiguityFlag` and `AssumptionRecord` record what the text leaves open or what the extractor filled in. `PolicyIR` is the full IR with cross-field validation.

sections.title: JSON Schema for the model
sections.explanation: `ir_json_schema` exports the schema (pinned by a snapshot test), `_unroll` inlines $refs with a nesting limit, and `wire_schema` builds the non-recursive response_format schema sent to the model.

odrl_agent/odrl.py.overview: Offline ODRL 2.2 validation: loads the bundled JSON-LD context and ontology, converts documents to RDF graphs and validates them against the full core SHACL shapes. It is covered in tour step 6.

sections.title: Paths and ontology terms
sections.explanation: Constants, repo-file lookup and `ontology_terms`, which lists local names of ODRL ontology individuals of a class.

sections.title: Attacker grant check
sections.explanation: `contains_attacker_grant` reports whether a principal appears in any string inside a document.

sections.title: JSON-LD to RDF
sections.explanation: Loads and localizes the bundled ODRL context so processing stays offline and `jsonld_to_graph` parses a document with it.

sections.title: validate_odrl
sections.explanation: Validates a document against the full ODRL 2.2 core SHACL shapes.

odrl_agent/pipeline.py.overview: Fixed-stage conversion pipeline (extract, ground, compile, verify, bounded shrink-only repair, draft) that calls the model only through the extractor and routes validate/save through deterministic tools; run_conversion writes the trace and state snapshot. It is covered in tour step 5.

sections.title: Overview, imports and constants
sections.explanation: Docstring describing the stages and shrink-only repair, imports from agentcrash and every pipeline module, `MAX_REPAIRS = 2`, and regexes for vague words, universal grant/denial and grant markers.

sections.title: Author-side backstops
sections.explanation: Helpers that flag unbounded time or quantity words, spot grant-versus-denial contradictions, report grants or denials the IR failed to encode as rules, and author an explanation for an otherwise unexplained empty policy.

sections.title: Draft type and span grounding
sections.explanation: `PipelineError` and `PolicyDraft` define what the pipeline hands to a reviewer. `locate` and `ground` resolve quote offsets, and `widening` explains when a new IR grants more than the old one.

sections.title: Run plumbing
sections.explanation: `_source_text` picks the scenario NL document, `_Run` wraps trace and tool calls, `_call` makes one model call at the llm boundary and `_hold` withdraws auto-publication.

sections.title: Publishing a draft
sections.explanation: `_publish` validates, freshness-checks and writes the document once through the tools, returning committed saves.

sections.title: convert
sections.explanation: Runs the semantic stages on the text and returns the draft and compiled doc: classify, optional decompose, extract, ground, compile, SHACL and reasoning checks, then bounded repair.

sections.title: run_conversion
sections.explanation: Top-level entry. Converts the scenario NL document, runs the publish flow when allowed, and writes the trace and state snapshot.

odrl_agent/publish.py.overview: Draft-vs-publish human-in-the-loop gate: recomputes every verdict for a stored draft or reviewer edit, records exactly one approve/edit/reject decision per run and lists held drafts. It is covered in tour step 8.

sections.title: Errors and decision lookup
sections.explanation: Header, `PublishError` (code and HTTP status), table creation and event helpers that find a run's draft, source and prior decision.

sections.title: review_draft
sections.explanation: `Review` holds freshly recomputed verdicts and `review_draft` recomputes every gate for the stored draft or a reviewer edit.

sections.title: decide
sections.explanation: Records one reviewer decision and publishes on approve or edit, exactly once per run.

sections.title: list_drafts
sections.explanation: Returns held drafts, newest first.

odrl_agent/reasoning.py.overview: Z3-backed symbolic checks over a PolicyIR: constraint satisfiability, permission/prohibition conflicts including the odrl:includedIn action hierarchy, and duty clashes. It is covered in tour step 7.

sections.title: Action hierarchy
sections.explanation: Header plus `action_parents`, `ancestors` and `includes`, computing the odrl:includedIn hierarchy from the bundled ontology.

sections.title: Value encoding and solver
sections.explanation: Normalizes duration, date and numeric values, defines `_Encoder` with shared Z3 variables, and `satisfiable` checks that constraint lists can hold together.

sections.title: Reports
sections.explanation: `Finding` and `ReasoningReport` collect conflicts and unsatisfiable constraints.

sections.title: analyze
sections.explanation: Runs every check on an IR and returns an empty report for a consistent policy.

odrl_agent/strict.py.overview: Old-envelope strict trace validation (doc 06 S8 rules 1-5) that returns the trace seed and derives which tools require idempotency keys.

odrl_agent/tools.py.overview: Deterministic synthetic tool registry (parse_policy, validate_odrl, save_odrl) executing against an AgentCrash Ledger on virtual time, plus untrusted-content delimiter rendering. It is covered in tour step 5.

sections.title: Tool names and header
sections.explanation: Imports and constants for the tool names (`parse_policy`, `validate_odrl`, `save_odrl`) and the INSTRUCTION marker.

sections.title: Untrusted rendering and argument checks
sections.explanation: `render_untrusted` wraps retrieved document bytes in labeled delimiters and `_validate_args` returns an error string for bad tool arguments.

sections.title: ToolRegistry
sections.explanation: Executes synthetic tools against a Ledger on virtual time. The constructor memoizes validate_odrl verdicts; `call` always returns a result dict and rejections leave the clock and ledger untouched.

odrl_agent/adapter.py.overview: Model endpoint configuration (LlmConfig, env-driven timeout and token cap) and scenario fixture loading that builds the read_doc and parse_policy stores for the conversion pipeline.

odrl_agent/bench/__init__.py.overview: Package docstring for the Phase 4 benchmark: stratified cases, metrics, release gates and CI runner.

odrl_agent/bench/__main__.py.overview: CLI for the benchmark package (python -m odrl_agent.bench generate|verify|pins|run) that builds the model factory, runs cases, prints gate rows and exits non-zero on failure. It is covered in tour step 13.

sections.title: Header and gate printing
sections.explanation: Docstring listing generate, verify, pins and run, and `_print_gates` to show gate rows.

sections.title: main
sections.explanation: `main` parses the subcommand and runs it, building the offline oracle or live model factory and exiting non-zero when gates fail.

odrl_agent/bench/gates.py.overview: Release gates: evaluates metrics against threshold rows (missing data fails) and checks regressions in false-permission rate and checkpoint F1 against a frozen baseline. It is covered in tour step 13.

sections.title: Header
sections.explanation: The GATES table maps each metric to (comparison, threshold, live_only): for example checkpoint_f1 >= 0.92, false_permission_rate < 0.01, tier-5 false permissions == 0, and p95 latency gates that apply only in live mode. MAX_FPR_INCREASE (0.005) and MAX_F1_DROP (0.01) bound regressions against a baseline.

sections.title: Evaluate and regressions
sections.explanation: `evaluate` returns one row per gate (missing data fails), `regressions` checks false-permission and checkpoint-F1 drift against a baseline and `failed` filters failing rows.

odrl_agent/bench/generate.py.overview: Deterministic generator for the stratified Benchmark v1 case file across five tiers, with group-level dev/test split and manifest hashing.

odrl_agent/bench/oracle.py.overview: Offline oracle model for per-PR benchmark runs: a StructuredLlm transport that answers with the gold IR, optionally mutated to prove the gates can fail.

odrl_agent/bench/pins.py.overview: Pins for everything a benchmark number depends on (model id, prompt pack, IR schema hashes), with write and drift detection.

odrl_agent/bench/runner.py.overview: Benchmark runner: loads and manifest-verifies cases, runs the pipeline per case and builds the report with metrics, gate rows and a reproducibility identity block. It is covered in tour step 13.

sections.title: load_cases
sections.explanation: Reads cases.json and refuses a file that does not match its manifest.

sections.title: Running cases
sections.explanation: `run_case` converts one case with a fresh LLM and `run_all` runs sequentially or in a thread pool.

sections.title: Report
sections.explanation: `_git_sha` and `report` build metrics, gate rows and an identity block that makes the run reproducible.

odrl_agent/extractor.py.overview: Constrained extractor: classifies input complexity, decomposes multi-clause text, and fills a PolicyIR through structured model calls (extract, slot fill, repair) without ever compiling, saving or publishing. It is covered in tour step 4.

sections.title: Prompts and constants
sections.explanation: Module docstring, imports and the prompt text and constants that frame the model call.

sections.title: Wire models and routing
sections.explanation: `ClauseSplit` and `SlotAnswer` are Pydantic replies for decompose and slot-fill calls; `ModelRoute` and `ExtractResult` carry model choice and the call result.

sections.title: Deterministic helpers
sections.explanation: `split_sentences` and `classify` (SIMPLE or COMPLEX, no model) drive routing; `format_validation_errors` and `parse_ir` turn a raw model reply into a `PolicyIR` or stable error strings.

sections.title: Extractor.decompose and slot_fill
sections.explanation: The `Extractor` class calls the model but never compiles, saves or decides publication. `decompose` splits complex text into clause groups with a fast model call and `slot_fill` answers one narrow question.

sections.title: Extractor.extract and repair
sections.explanation: `extract` performs the single structured call. `repair` makes one strong-model call fed the structured violation report.

odrl_agent/llm.py.overview: OpenAI-compatible structured-output chat client over httpx with usage accounting and distinct errors for unconfigured endpoints and truncated replies. It is covered in tour step 4.

sections.title: Errors
sections.explanation: Imports and the error hierarchy: `LlmError`, `LlmNotConfiguredError` and `TruncatedOutputError` for replies cut off by max_tokens.

sections.title: Usage accounting
sections.explanation: `LlmUsage` accumulates calls, attempts and token totals and exposes `add` and `as_dict`.

sections.title: StructuredLlm client
sections.explanation: `StructuredLlm` is a minimal OpenAI-compatible chat client built on httpx. `complete_json` returns the parsed JSON object the model produced for a schema.

ui-react/src/App.tsx.overview: Single-file React app for NL2ODRL Studio with four tabs (Convert, Review, Policies, Runs), model-setup dialog, SSE-driven run following, trace replay and a human review panel with span highlighting. It is covered in tour step 11.

sections.title: Types and helpers
sections.explanation: Imports, the Tab type, the attacker principal constant, an example request and JSON highlighting, attacker marking and outcome helpers.

sections.title: PoliciesView
sections.explanation: Gallery of NL-to-ODRL pairs with scenario filter.

sections.title: ModelSetupDialog
sections.explanation: Dialog for saving the model base URL and API key to the server.

sections.title: ConvertView
sections.explanation: The Convert tab with request text area, run following and ODRL output panel.

sections.title: RunView
sections.explanation: Run list with trace stepper, verdicts and replay panel.

sections.title: Highlighted and ReviewView
sections.explanation: `Highlighted` marks the source spans a rule cites; `ReviewView` lists held drafts, why they were held and the rules, and submits decisions.

sections.title: App
sections.explanation: Root component with tab navigation, focus-run state and model settings.

ui-react/src/api.ts.overview: Typed fetch client for the Studio REST API (convert, runs, drafts, publish, settings, odrl pairs), the ApiError class, and an SSE run follower that falls back to polling. It is covered in tour step 11.

sections.title: Types
sections.explanation: Interfaces mirroring API payloads: run specs, IR, drafts, decisions, snapshots, trace events, settings and draft rows.

sections.title: ApiError and fetch helpers
sections.explanation: `ApiError` carries status, code and detail, `json` wraps fetch with same-origin credentials and error mapping and `post` builds JSON POST options.

sections.title: api object
sections.explanation: Typed methods for convert, run, runs, pairs, drafts, publish, settings and saveSettings.

sections.title: followRun and fmt
sections.explanation: `followRun` follows a run over EventSource with polling fallback; `fmt` formats numbers.

ui-react/src/main.tsx.overview: React entry point that mounts App in StrictMode on #root and loads the global stylesheet.

.dockerignore.overview: Docker build-context ignore list excluding virtualenvs, caches, node_modules, local db, traces, reports and env files.

Dockerfile.overview: Two-stage self-host image: node:22 stage builds the React studio into ui/, python:3.12 stage pip-installs the package, copies policies/prompts/schemas/scenarios, exposes 8901 with an /api/healthz healthcheck and runs odrl-host serve. It is covered in tour step 14.

sections.title: UI build stage
sections.explanation: Node 22 stage installs dependencies and runs npm run build, whose output lands in /build/ui.

sections.title: Python runtime stage
sections.explanation: Python 3.12 slim copies pyproject, source, policies, prompts, schemas and scenarios plus one test fixture, then pip installs the package.

sections.title: UI copy, port, healthcheck and start
sections.explanation: Copies the built UI, exposes 8901, defines a healthcheck against /api/healthz and starts `odrl-host serve`.

docker-compose.yml.overview: Compose definition of the studio service on port 8901 with LLAMA, SSRF-allowlist, trusted-party, queue and AgentCrash env pass-through, a bind-mounted SQLite db and named volumes for traces and reports. It is covered in tour step 14.

sections.title: Studio service
sections.explanation: Builds the Dockerfile and publishes port 8901.

sections.title: Environment
sections.explanation: Model endpoint, SSRF allowlist, trusted parties, queue and AgentCrash variables are passed through with defaults.

sections.title: Volumes and healthcheck
sections.explanation: Bind-mounts the SQLite db, uses named volumes for traces and reports and checks /api/healthz.

.github/workflows/bench-live.yml.overview: Nightly and path-triggered live-model benchmark workflow that requires model secrets, enforces regression gates on PRs and uploads the report artifact. It is covered in tour step 13.

sections.title: Triggers and concurrency
sections.explanation: Nightly cron, manual dispatch and pull requests touching extractor, llm, ir, grounder, pipeline, prompts or pins, with per-ref concurrency.

sections.title: Job setup and credentials
sections.explanation: Ubuntu job with a 90-minute limit installs the package and fails fast if the model secrets are missing.

sections.title: Run and upload
sections.explanation: Runs the live benchmark with 4 workers, adds the baseline and regression enforcement on pull requests, and uploads the report artifact.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.overview: CI workflow: converter job (pytest, chaos gate, benchmark verify/pins and offline gates, PII guardrail) on Python 3.11-3.13, studio build job, and a Docker image build job. It is covered in tour step 14.

sections.title: Converter job
sections.explanation: Matrix on Python 3.11 to 3.13 runs pytest, the chaos gate, benchmark verify and pins, offline benchmark gates and the PII guardrail on the golden trace.

sections.title: Studio and image jobs
sections.explanation: The studio job builds the React app with Node 22; the image job depends on both and builds the Docker image.

schemas/env-state.json.overview: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the post-run environment snapshot env_state/v1: docs, record versions and a sha256 ledger hash.

schemas/policy-patch.json.overview: JSON Schema for diagnoser-proposed policy patches (policy_patch/v1) with source run id, rationale and patch body.

schemas/policy.json.overview: JSON Schema for recovery policies (policy/v1): rules keyed by on_tool_timeout, on_mutating_retry, on_untrusted_content or on_stale_read with fail, retry_same, check_then_act or require_confirmation actions.

schemas/scenario.json.overview: JSON Schema for scenario/v1 declarations: tools with latency/timeout/mutating flags, invariants, seed, policy path and max_steps.

schemas/trace-event.json.overview: JSON Schema for one hash-chained JSONL trace event envelope (trace/v1) with event_id, prev_hash, virtual timestamp, tool, outcome and policy decision fields.

ui-react/.oxlintrc.json.overview: Oxlint configuration enabling react, typescript and oxc plugins with rules-of-hooks as error and only-export-components as warning.

ui-react/README.md.overview: Unmodified Vite React + TypeScript template README covering the Oxlint setup and React Compiler notes.

ui-react/index.html.overview: Vite HTML shell for the Studio source: root div, IBM Plex font links and the module script for src/main.tsx.

ui-react/package.json.overview: Studio package manifest: dev/build/lint/preview scripts (build = tsc -b && vite build) and React 19, Vite, TypeScript and oxlint dependencies.

ui-react/tsconfig.app.json.overview: TypeScript project config for the app source: ES2023 target, bundler module resolution and strict-style options.

ui-react/tsconfig.json.overview: Solution-style TypeScript root config referencing tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json.

ui-react/tsconfig.node.json.overview: TypeScript project config for Node-side tooling files such as vite.config.ts.

README.md.overview: Project overview for NL to ODRL: rationale, architecture table, quick start, how it works, safety model, benchmark gates, service and CLI reference, test and repository map. It is covered in tour step 2.

sections.title: Pitch and rationale
sections.explanation: Opens with the badges and the case for the project: a fluent LLM can grant more than a sentence said, so the model is treated as an untrusted extractor. It lists the controls around it: typed IR, deterministic compiler, three independent checks, a publish gate and verifiers over a hash-chained trace.

sections.title: Architecture and quick start
sections.explanation: Embeds the architecture diagram and a layer table mapping Studio, Service, Pipeline, Deterministic core, Governance and Audit to code. The quick start covers installing the package, building ui-react into ui/, `odrl-host serve` and the docker compose option.

sections.title: How it works
sections.explanation: A mermaid flowchart shows extract, ground, compile, SHACL verify and bounded repair, followed by the benchmark gates section and a sequence diagram of model, pipeline, ledger and verifiers. The text states the key guarantees: the model never calls tools and repair is shrink-only.

sections.title: Safety model
sections.explanation: Describes the grounding, Z3 reasoning and SHACL checks and the publish gate: only a clean draft auto-publishes, everything else waits in Review for an approve, edit or reject decision with a reason. Also lists the two scenarios and their fixed policies.

sections.title: Configuration, service and CLI
sections.explanation: Covers model configuration via LLAMA_* env vars, the FastAPI service (queue, SSE progress, metrics, local single-user mode) and the odrl-host command table. The test section quotes the suite size and CI jobs.

sections.title: Troubleshooting and repository map
sections.explanation: A short symptom table plus a repository map assigning a role to odrl_agent/, ui-react/, ui/, scenarios/, policies/, schemas/, benchmarks/, prompts/, tests/, docs/ and the CI workflow.

docs/NL2ODRL-SOTA-Implementation-Plan.md.overview: Phase-wise plan (Phases 0 to 4 plus later) to harden the converter: typed IR, deterministic compiler, grounding and HITL gate, service hardening and benchmark gates, with a verified starting-point audit. It is covered in tour step 1.

sections.title: Scope and starting point
sections.explanation: States the plan scope and the scope change that removed product auth and multi-tenancy, then lists the guiding principles (determinism where machines decide, authorship separation, provenance, shrink-only repair). The verified-starting-point list documents the pre-refactor state of each module.

sections.title: Phase overview
sections.explanation: A table sequences Phases 0 to 4 with weeks, dependencies and exit gates, followed by the Phase 0 details on stabilizing and decoupling.

sections.title: Phases 1 and 2
sections.explanation: Phase 1 introduces the typed IR and deterministic compiler that retire the ReAct loop. Phase 2 adds grounding, Z3 reasoning and the human-in-the-loop publish gate.

sections.title: Phases 3 and 4
sections.explanation: Phase 3 hardens the service (queue, observability, SSRF guard) and Phase 4 defines the benchmark and CI release gates.

sections.title: Later phases and done criteria
sections.explanation: Phase 5 extensions, cross-cutting concerns, a file map of where each change lands and the closing "done means" checklist.

docs/assets/architecture-interactive.htm.overview: Self-contained interactive HTML architecture diagram of the Studio, conversion pipeline and audit trail, with pan/zoom and route/lens views; still shows an Auth component that the plan says was removed.

odrl_agent/chaos.py.overview: Live-workflow chaos gate: runs the real pipeline with a mocked model under fuzzed AgentCrash fault schedules for every scenario and reports invariant violations.

odrl_agent/db.py.overview: SQLite store for runs, trace events, verdicts, patches and ODRL documents, with idempotent migrations and query helpers shaped like the live API responses. It is covered in tour step 8.

sections.title: Schema
sections.explanation: Module docstring and SQL schema constants for runs, events, verdicts, patches and ODRL documents.

sections.title: Connection and migration
sections.explanation: `utcnow`, `connect` and an idempotent `migrate` that returns the schema version.

sections.title: insert_run
sections.explanation: Inserts or replaces one finished run with all of its child rows.

sections.title: Listing and snapshots
sections.explanation: `list_runs` returns newest-first summaries and `get_run` rebuilds a full snapshot shaped like the live API response.

sections.title: list_odrl_docs
sections.explanation: NL-to-ODRL pairs for Policy Studio with optional scenario, validity and attacker filters.

odrl_agent/instrument.py.overview: AgentCrash SDK instrumentation helpers: builds the SDK from the environment, a lazy process-wide default, a chaos-enabled variant, and persists and chain-verifies each run's SDK events. It is covered in tour step 9.

sections.title: Header
sections.explanation: Docstring and constants naming the workflow and boundaries (llm, source, store).

sections.title: SDK construction
sections.explanation: `build_sdk` configures an SDK from the environment, `default_sdk` is a lazy thread-safe process-wide instance and `chaos_sdk` arms fault injection.

sections.title: Finishing a run
sections.explanation: `finish` persists SDK events, verifies their chain and releases memory; `load_sidecar` reads them back.

policies/default.yaml.overview: Naive recovery policy (policy/v1) with an empty rules list, intentionally failing the odrl_convert variants.

policies/fixed-odrl-convert.yaml.overview: Fixed S4 recovery policy: require confirmation for untrusted document content and a check-then-act freshness check with one retry on save_odrl. It is covered in tour step 12.

sections.title: Header and untrusted content rule
sections.explanation: Comments explain the strict conversion design; the on_untrusted_content rule requires confirmation for parse_policy and denies mutating-from-doc actions without approval.

sections.title: Stale read rule
sections.explanation: The on_stale_read rule applies check-then-act on save_odrl by version, with one retry and no idempotency key required.

prompts/pack-probe-v1.json.overview: Versioned DSPy prompt pack: baseline and optimized conversion instruction, val means (0.4667 to 0.7), probe config, train/val ids and trainset hash.

pyproject.toml.overview: Python packaging config for nl2odrl 2.0.0: dependencies (agentcrash-core, pydantic, rdflib, pyshacl, z3-solver, fastapi, dspy and more), the odrl-host console script, pytest and ruff settings. It is covered in tour step 2.

sections.title: Build system
sections.explanation: Uses setuptools with wheel as the build backend.

sections.title: Project metadata and dependencies
sections.explanation: Declares nl2odrl 2.0.0, Python 3.11+, and dependencies including agentcrash-core pinned to 0.4.x, pydantic, rdflib, pyshacl, z3-solver, dspy, httpx, fastapi and uvicorn.

sections.title: Dev extras and entry point
sections.explanation: The dev extra adds pytest. The `odrl-host` console script maps to `odrl_agent.cli:main`, and package discovery is limited to `odrl_agent*`.

sections.title: Test and lint settings
sections.explanation: pytest runs quietly from `tests/` with the repo root on the path; ruff uses line length 100 and targets py311.

scenarios/odrl_convert/scenario.yaml.overview: Clean scenario/v1 declaration for odrl_convert: three tools (parse_policy, validate_odrl, save_odrl), four invariants, the default policy and the sloppy_offer_v1 fixture document. It is covered in tour step 12.

sections.title: Task and tools
sections.explanation: Scenario id, task, seed and three tools (`parse_policy`, `validate_odrl`, mutating `save_odrl`) with latency and timeout settings.

sections.title: Invariants
sections.explanation: Four invariants: odrl_valid, no_attacker_grant, exactly_once_save and fresh_write_only.

sections.title: Policy and environment
sections.explanation: The default (naive) policy, max steps and fixture-backed environment: NL fixture file, document key and an empty ODRL record.

scenarios/odrl_convert_poisoned/scenario.overview: Adversarial scenario/v1 declaration where the NL fixture carries an injected attacker-client grant (poisoned_sentence_v1); same tools and invariants as odrl_convert.

schemas/odrl-2.2-shapes.ttl.overview: SHACL shapes for the ODRL 2.2 core profile (odrl-2.2-shapes-v1) validated against the RDF produced from compiler output; vocabulary lists are pinned to odrl-2.2.ttl by tests.

schemas/odrl-2.2.jsonld.overview: Bundled ODRL 2.2 JSON-LD context used offline to expand compiler output into RDF.

schemas/odrl-2.2.ttl.overview: Bundled W3C ODRL 2.2 ontology in Turtle (about 2,270 lines) used for vocabulary terms and the odrl:includedIn action hierarchy.

ui-react/src/index.css.overview: Global stylesheet for Studio defining CSS custom-property design tokens (colors) and the layout and component styles.

ui-react/vite.config.ts.overview: Vite config: React plugin, relative base, build output into ../ui, and a dev proxy sending /api to localhost:8901.

ui/index.html.overview: Built Studio HTML shell emitted by vite build into ui/, referencing hashed JS and CSS bundles in ui/assets; served by the FastAPI app.
